feeds.title: Fresh Medical Aesthetics Blog
feeds.description: Fresh Medical Aesthetics is a progressive med spa in beautiful downtown Plymouth, MA. We offer a wide range of aesthetic services and nonsurgical cosmetic procedures including Botox, Dysport, Xeomin, Dermal Filler treatments including Juvederm and Restylane, medical grade skin care products and chemical peels, and more. Read our blog to understand more about our products, our facility, methods used, and informative articles.

feeds.title: Girl & Tonic
feeds.description: This is my space to write and is my raw, honest journey towards loving myself more, exploring the world stone-cold sober and improving my wellbeing.

feeds.title: SoberPunks
feeds.description: Soberpunks.co.uk is a sweary alcohol recovery blog that is written by mid-thirties ex-drinker Jon Turner. Soberpunks.co.uk was launched in September 2016, to mark his first year of sobriety. Since its launch, Jon's blog has received praise for its honesty, wanking jokes, and non-patronizing approach to offering advice and support.

feeds.title: Be Sober
feeds.description: Simon Chapple is a bestselling author of How to Quit Alcohol in 50 Days and The Sober Survival Guide, he is also a speaker and sobriety coach. Simon shares a wealth of content and resources on his blog to help anyone who wants to change their relationship with alcohol.

feeds.title: Sober News
feeds.description: Sober Socials brings readers Sober news, sober features, recovery stories, alcohol-free drink reviews from UK & Ireland. Sober News is a news as well as information hub organizing Alcohol-free events and meetups for the sober and sober curious in the UK and Ireland

feeds.title: Sober News - Sober Socials
feeds.description: Sober Socials is a free online resource to help sober and sober-curious people find sober events and connections. I am a writer and amateur comic who went alcohol-free after becoming alcohol-dependent. Since ditching the booze, I have been trying to find joy in sobriety by forging new social circles, organizing and attending sober events, and pursuing all sorts of new interests - from stand-up comedy to wild swimming, from gong baths to alcohol-free cocktail making.

feeds.title: Club Soda
feeds.description: Club Soda is a supportive community for people wanting to change their drinking: cut down, stop for a bit or quit. Want to know about mindful drinking, non-drinking, our courses or events? Check our blog with hundreds of articles about life, alcohol, mindfulness, and more.

feeds.title: Sober Diary
feeds.description: Hi, I am, as my blog name suggests trying to 'go sober' and join the many thousands of people out there already 'dry' and abstaining from alcohol. I am a 34 (nearly 35) year old singer from North-East England and I live with my partner, 3 little girls, and our dog. I'm hoping using this blog for accountability and support will help me achieve my goal. I'm hoping to connect with others in the online world that are in a similar position or have been in the past to try and remain accountable and continue on this path, please let me know if you are reading

feeds.title: Woman on a Sober Mission
feeds.description: My name is Carmela, AKA Woman on a sober mission. I am a Essex girl living in the UK and Founder of Totiuss - a female empowerment company helping women improve their physical and mental health whilst addressing their relationship with alcohol. This blog documents my personal sobriety and mental health journey looking at all things sobriety related, mental health and fitness. I am a big believer in knowledge being power and that AA isn't the only route to sobriety.
